name: @va-team/nabu-files
description: Routes outbound tool media and inbound channel attachments to the Nabu Files API on NestJS so binaries live in MinIO/Hetzner instead of accumulating on disk. Per-user isolation: uploads/resolves are scoped solely by userId via the x-user-id header (senw-core 2026-06-01 contract — x-channel is no longer sent).

apiToken.description: Platform skill-token issued by NestJS Files API module (purpose=files-api); authenticates the gateway as a trusted transport. Per-user ownership is carried solely by the x-user-id request header (senw-core 2026-06-01 contract), not this token. Accepts either a literal string or a SecretRef object {source, provider, id} resolved from env.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Per-request HTTP timeout for skill-upload and skill-resolve calls. Default 30s.

maxRetries.description: Number of retry attempts on transient failure. Default 3.

maxConcurrentUploads.description: Self-imposed cap on parallel uploads per chat turn to avoid quota-SUM race. Default 8.
